scope: Bounded exact-recipient authorized listing for one exact stored notification group key

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.ownership_scope: exact non-nil tenant and recipient identities supplied by an authorized caller
policy.group_key: one exact opaque trimmed non-control key between 1 and 191 bytes
policy.page_bounds: default 20 and hard maximum 64 raw rows
policy.cursor: reuse the versioned i1 inbox cursor with timestamp nanoseconds and UUID tie-breaker
policy.selection: filter tenant recipient group key and optional state before stable created_at descending id descending selection
policy.authorization: reuse NotificationInboxOpenService so current recipient privacy precedes source target authorization
policy.sparse_progress: derive continuation from the last scanned raw group row rather than the last allowed item
policy.response: reuse NotificationInboxPage and NotificationInboxItem without route or structural target fields
policy.empty_foreign_result: missing groups and foreign tenant or recipient scopes return an empty page
policy.failure: retryable privacy or source failures abort the page without a partial result
policy.mutation_boundary: group listing mutates no inbox timestamp or delivery attempt
policy.population_boundary: the read consumes only already stored non-null group keys; production candidate grouping policy remains separate
policy.transport_boundary: no HTTP GraphQL native server function admin or storefront adapter is delivered

not_delivered: source or notifications grouping policy and production group key population
